en.title: Preliminary Screening Report: Suspected Unauthorized Site Modification in Wetland Buffer Area (DB-0001)
en.summary: Remote sensing detection on 2025-04-15 identified potential surface disturbance covering approximately 1.42 hectares within the Wetland Buffer Area (WBA). Satellite radar backscatter increased by 5.9 dB and NDWI decreased by 0.35, indicating loss of open water or surface moisture consistent with filling or ground clearance.
evidence: First detected via satellite observations on 2025-04-15.
Radar backscatter delta: +5.9 dB, indicating significant structural alteration of the land surface.
Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) delta: -0.35, suggesting a reduction in surface moisture or pond desiccation.
statutory_basis: Town Planning Board Guidelines (TPB PG-NO. 12C), Section 6.4: Intention of the Wetland Buffer Area (WBA) to protect the ecological integrity of fish ponds and wetlands in the WCA.
Town Planning Board Guidelines (TPB PG-NO. 12C), Section 6.5: Requirement for planning permission and ecological impact assessments for developments or redevelopments within the WBA.
Town Planning Board Guidelines (TPB PG-NO. 12C), Section 6.6: Restriction against new open storage or container back-up uses within the WBA.
en.recommended_action: Conduct an urgent on-site inspection to verify the nature of ground operations, verify whether valid planning permission has been obtained from the Town Planning Board, and evaluate whether statutory enforcement action under the Town Planning Ordinance is warranted.
en.limitations: Findings are based on satellite imagery analytics and statutory guidelines. Ground truthing and land registry searches are required to confirm actual land use and ownership.

zh_hant.title: 初步執法審查簡報：濕地緩衝區疑似未經許可土地作業 (DB-0001)
zh_hant.summary: 遙感監測於 2025 年 4 月 15 日在濕地緩衝區（WBA）內偵測到約 1.42 公頃的懷疑地面擾動。雷達後向散射增加 5.9 dB，且歸一化水體指數（NDWI）下降 0.35，顯示水體或地表水分減少，符合填土或平整特徵。
evidence: 受影響土地面積：約 1.42 公頃。
首次衛星監測日期：2025 年 4 月 15 日。
雷達後向散射變化：+5.9 dB，顯示地表結構顯著改變。
歸一化水體指數 (NDWI) 變化：-0.35，顯示地表水分減少或魚塘乾涸。
statutory_basis: 城市規劃委員會規劃指引 (TPB PG-NO. 12C) 第 6.4 段：濕地緩衝區的規劃意向是保護濕地保育區內魚塘和濕地的生態完整性。
城市規劃委員會規劃指引 (TPB PG-NO. 12C) 第 6.5 段：濕地緩衝區內需要規劃許可的發展或重建項目須提交生態影響評估。
城市規劃委員會規劃指引 (TPB PG-NO. 12C) 第 6.6 段：濕地緩衝區內通常不允許設立露天貯物或貨櫃後勤用途。
zh_hant.recommended_action: 進行緊急實地視察以核實地面工程性質，查核是否已獲城市規劃委員會發出的有效規劃許可，並評估是否須根據《城市規劃條例》採取執管行動。
zh_hant.limitations: 本簡報基於衛星影像分析及法定規劃指引，須經實地勘查及查冊確認實際土地用途及業權。
